title.zh: 银行（第 15A 与 15B 条豁免）命令 2010
title.vi: Lệnh Ngân hàng (Miễn trừ theo Điều 15A và 15B) 2010
title.th: คำสั่งการธนาคาร (การยกเว้นตามมาตรา 15A และ 15B) 2010

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Banking (Exemption from Sections 15A and 15B) Order 2010 and shall come into operation on 29th January 2010.

2. The Minister hereby exempts any shareholder of Oversea-Chinese Banking Corporation Limited —
(a)from section 15A(1) of the Act, where that shareholder, by virtue of its shareholdings in Oversea-Chinese Banking Corporation Limited, is or becomes a substantial shareholder of ING Asia Private Bank Limited; and
(b)from section 15B(1) of the Act, where that shareholder, by virtue of its shareholdings in Oversea-Chinese Banking Corporation Limited, is or becomes a 12% controller, a 20% controller or an indirect controller, as the case may be, of ING Asia Private Bank Limited.
